app.name: nescore (Retro Shelf edition)
app.long_description:
A cycle-accurate NES emulator for the Wii, in the style of Retro Shelf 8.
Start your games from Retro Shelf 8 (set emulator=sd:/apps/nescore/boot.dol in apps/retroshelf/config.ini), or from nescore's own game list (sd:/nes or sd:/roms/nes).
HOME opens the menu: point with the Wii Remote and press A. Hold B and press + to save, B and - to load. "Retro Shelf 8" in the menu takes you back to the shelf.
